Jev routing seam for ork:auto

PR for issue #4233. One typed judgment of the capability class per build shaped prompt, behind ORK_ROUTE_JEV, off by default. Nothing is ever blocked by the seam; a dead lane means the model reads the table as before.

Where the seam sits

UserPromptSubmitevery prompt
↓
prompt/unified-dispatcherruns the sub hooks in order, merges their context
↓
executor-route-nudge: build shaped?imperative build or fix verb, 40 chars or more, no explicit /plugin:skill. No: nothing.
↓
[seam] redact, egress guard, POST /v1/systemone, recordfive questions in one request, model jev-1.13.0, 3,000 ms, zero retries. Secret, email, phone, id or client name surviving redaction refuses the call.
↓
conf at or above floor and flag=steerinject one line: route: <class> -> /ork:<skill> (conf 0.xx). Else: the generic reminder, or nothing.
↓
model reads SKILL.md and the tables (unchanged)states whether it agrees with the prior, confirms, hands off through the Skill tool

Removable by deleting one branch in the handler. The confirm step and the Skill tool hand off are untouched, so the mutating misroute constraint stays where it was.

Flag and floor explorer

?prompts Jev decides (conf at or above floor)
?right among those, 150 gold rows (desk)
?route agreement on the 50 case ork benchmark at this floor

Sample prompt: fix the flaky retry logic in the upload endpoint and add a regression test for it. Measured verdict for it: dev_fix at conf 1.00, worktree 0.91, browser 0.10, mutation 1.4, operator 0.12, 909 ms through the child process.

The nineteen classes and where they land in OrchestKit

classwhat it coversork executor

dev maps to an executor skill or agent. ops belongs to the hq-ext front door and produces no ork nudge. never steered continuation and ambiguous produce no nudge anywhere.

The one log line

route jev: intent=dev_fix conf=0.86 top3=dev_fix:0.87,ops_deploy:0.13,ops_deps:0.00 worktree=0.85 browser=0.26 mutation=2.0 operator=0.24 floor=0.50 decided_by=table latency_ms=772 input_tokens=1320 redacted=0

decided_by is one of jev (steer, above the floor), table (shadow, or any fallback), off, budget (daily tokens spent or a 402/429 trip), egress (a leak survived redaction). The same fields land as one 0600 record in jev-route.jsonl in the session data directory, for example /Users/me/.claude/..., never with prompt text, only a sha256 of the redacted text.

What leaves the machine

state = {
  prompt: first 1500 chars after redaction,
  opening_turn: true | false,
  repo: basename of the project dir
}

Redaction tokens: [SECRET] (bearer, token=, JWT, ghp_, github_pat_, sk-, xox, AKIA, apik, ops_, op:// refs, 40 hex, nine digit ids), [EMAIL], [PHONE] (05x and +972 shapes), [CLIENT] (directory names under clients/, the spaced form and long segments). The serialized request is scanned again in raw and JSON decoded forms before it leaves.
